The task is to list all opened issues that ask about OPT model related questions. python_code:
async def act(page):
    # Get all links on the page
    all_links = page.get_by_role('link')
    count = await all_links.count()
    
    # List to store OPT-related issue titles
    opt_issue_titles = []
    
    for i in range(count):
        link = all_links.nth(i)
        href = await link.get_attribute('href')
        text = await link.text_content()
        
        # Check if it's an issue link and contains 'opt' in the text (case-insensitive)
        if href and href.startswith('/root/metaseq/issues/') and 'opt' in text.lower():
            opt_issue_titles.append(text.strip())
    
    # Return the list as a string, one per line
    result = '\n'.join(opt_issue_titles) if opt_issue_titles else 'No OPT-related issues found.'
    return result
